tips.title: Materials that work together
tips.spark: What if the material palette felt a little calmer?
tips.advice: Pair the oak sideboard with warm, matte walls and linen upholstery. Check real material samples in daylight and under your evening lighting.

tips.title: A softer evening atmosphere
tips.spark: Could softer light change the way this room feels at night?
tips.advice: Try dimmable 2700K wall lighting with a separate reading lamp beside the sofa. Layers of light give you more control over the room’s evening atmosphere.

tips.title: Room to move, not just to look
tips.spark: Could a small furniture adjustment open up this walkway?
tips.advice: Keep the route to the window clear when positioning the chair and side table. Confirm door swings, socket access and furniture dimensions before final placement.

faqs: How do I get started?
Open the Briller studio, create an account and add a room photo or sketch. You can then add references and describe the direction you want to explore.
Will Briller preserve my room’s geometry?

Briller is designed to use the existing walls, doors and windows as constraints. Check each generated image against your original room; AI results are visual concepts, not construction drawings or a guarantee of exact geometry.
What can I upload?
The workflow accepts room photos or sketches, style references and optional architectural drawings. Check the studio upload interface for current supported file types and size limits.
Can I talk to Briller in Ukrainian?
Yes. Briller supports natural-language interaction, including English and Ukrainian, with text and voice input.
What is included in the Free plan?
Up to 3 active projects, 20 iterations per month, a Designed with Briller watermark and basic assistant suggestions.
How do credits and top-ups work?

Paid plans include a monthly credit allowance. Additional credit packs do not expire. Operation costs, renewal timing and any subscription-credit rollover rules should be checked in the app before purchase.
Where do I pay or manage my subscription?

Billing takes place in the Briller app through Stripe. Subscription management is available through the Stripe Customer Portal in your account. Check the portal for cancellation options and the effective end date.
Can I use a render commercially?
The Studio / Architect plan includes a commercial licence according to the supplied plan specification. Review the final Terms of Service and your plan entitlements before commercial use.
Are my projects public?

The website inspiration gallery contains curated reference photography. It does not read or publish private app projects. The app’s data retention, sharing and AI-processing policies must be confirmed in its final Privacy Policy.
Are Briller’s suggestions construction advice?
Use them as design ideas to discuss with qualified professionals. Verify measurements, structural changes, lighting, electrical work and material installation before implementation.
How can I contact support?
Email hello@briller.house with your question. Avoid including passwords, payment details or sensitive project information.
